id: 23_Replace the Laser Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机更换激光电源
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/23_Replace the Laser Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/23_Replace the Laser Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K1: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
points.K2: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
points.K4: 准备工具和新激光电源
points.K7: 拆把手，最后一颗扶住把手
points.K9: 拆五根电源线，黄胶用镊子剥
points.K13: 支架装到新电源，挂钩朝外

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带脚轮的激光焊接机旁招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank gray wheeled handheld laser welding machine in a workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光焊接机怎样更换激光电源。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换激光电源

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：把手、侧盖、长条电源、支架
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a machine handle, a side cover, a long power supply module and a metal bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 拆把手左盖、换电源、装支架、装回。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下焊枪扳机，焊枪不出光，他皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the trigger of the welding gun but nothing happens, and he frowns.
shots.narration: 焊接机的激光电源坏了。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱，和小研抬着长条形新电源走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer carries a toolbox while the female graduate student brings a long new power supply module.
shots.narration: 专业技术人员老李来更换。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先看片头的安全警示。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 当心触电和当心激光两个警告标志并排
shots.prompt_en: An electric shock warning sign and a laser warning sign side by side on a yellow background. No people.
shots.narration: 激光焊接机里有高压，也有强激光。
overlay: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 触电和烧伤图标并排，下面一个惊叹号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electric shock and a burned hand side by side with a large exclamation mark below. No people.
shots.narration: 处理不当，会触电、烧伤。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 学生拿螺丝刀伸向机箱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student reaching toward a machine cabinet with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 非专业人员严禁拆机，动手前必须断电。

shots.section_title: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
shots.scene: 长条形电源图标里闪着电，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a long power supply module with a small lightning symbol inside and an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 激光电源断电后，还可能残留高压。
overlay: 残余高压，等够时间再碰

shots.section_title: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
shots.scene: 沙漏旁边一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass next to a clock icon with its hand sweeping round. No people.
shots.narration: 至少等5分钟，再去触碰。

shots.scene: 警示卡上一副绝缘手套图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning card with a yellow and black striped border showing an insulated glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 全过程戴绝缘手套。

shots.section_title: 准备工具和新激光电源
shots.scene: 木纹台面上一个长条形银色电源和一排工具
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a wooden workbench with a long silver power supply module, several screwdrivers, two hex wrenches and tweezers. No people.
shots.narration: 新激光电源，3和5毫米十字刀，3毫米一字刀，
overlay: 准备工具和新激光电源

shots.section_title: 准备工具和新激光电源
shots.scene: 两把大小不同的内六角扳手和一把镊子特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of two hex wrenches of different sizes and a pair of tweezers on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 5和2.5毫米内六角，还有镊子。

shots.scene: 老李拔下电源插头和其他线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls out the power plug and disconnects the other cables from the machine.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉全部线缆。

shots.scene: 老李把四个脚轮锁扣依次踩下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake levers of all four caster wheels one by one.
shots.narration: 锁好四个脚轮。

shots.section_title: 拆把手，最后一颗扶住把手
shots.scene: 老李用内六角扳手松把手螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loosens the handle screws with a hex wrench.
shots.narration: 5毫米内六角松开把手8颗螺丝。
overlay: 拆把手，最后一颗扶住把手

shots.section_title: 拆把手，最后一颗扶住把手
shots.scene: 老李一只手扶住把手，另一只手拧最后一颗螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the handle with one hand while removing the last screw with the other.
shots.narration: 拆最后一颗时扶住把手，防止掉落。

shots.scene: 老李拆下左盖螺丝，取下盖板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the left cover screw and lifts the side cover away.
shots.narration: 3毫米十字刀拆左盖螺丝，取下左盖。

shots.section_title: 拆五根电源线，黄胶用镊子剥
shots.scene: 机内长条电源一端，五根线接在端子上
shots.prompt_en: Inside the machine, one end of a long power supply module shows five wires connected to a terminal strip. No people.
shots.narration: 激光电源一端接着五根电源线。
overlay: 拆五根电源线，黄胶用镊子剥

shots.section_title: 拆五根电源线，黄胶用镊子剥
shots.scene: 老李徒手用十字螺丝刀逐根拆下端子线
shots.prompt_en: With bare hands, the facility engineer unscrews the terminal wires one by one with a cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 用5毫米十字刀，逐根拆下来。

shots.section_title: 拆五根电源线，黄胶用镊子剥
shots.scene: 老李用镊子剥掉端子上的黄色固定胶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses tweezers to peel yellow fixing glue off a terminal.
shots.narration: 端子上有黄色固定胶，用镊子剥掉。

shots.scene: 主板旁边一颗被圆圈标出的螺丝，螺丝刀拧下
shots.prompt_en: A screw near the circuit board is marked with a green circle and removed with a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 再用5毫米十字刀拆电源固定螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李双手把长条电源从左向右滑动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the long power supply from left to right with both hands.
shots.narration: 把电源从左往右滑。

shots.scene: 老李先抬起电源左端，再慢慢取出右端
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the left end of the power supply out first, then slowly pulls out the right end.
shots.narration: 先抬出左侧，再慢慢取出右侧。

shots.scene: 电源放在台面上，老李用小号内六角扳手拆支架
shots.prompt_en: The power supply lies on the bench; the facility engineer removes the bracket screws with a small hex wrench.
shots.narration: 2.5毫米内六角拆支架8颗螺丝。

shots.section_title: 支架装到新电源，挂钩朝外
shots.scene: 新电源和支架并排，支架上的挂钩被圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: The new power supply lies next to the metal bracket, its hooks marked with green circles. No people.
shots.narration: 把支架装到新电源上。
overlay: 支架装到新电源，挂钩朝外

shots.section_title: 支架装到新电源，挂钩朝外
shots.scene: 挂钩朝外的支架打勾，朝内的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a bracket with hooks facing outward with a green check, and hooks facing inward with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 注意方向：挂钩要朝外。

shots.section_title: 支架装到新电源，挂钩朝外
shots.scene: 老李拧紧支架螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the bracket screws on the new power supply.
shots.narration: 8颗螺丝拧紧。

shots.scene: 老李把新电源放回机内原位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the new power supply back into its place inside the machine.
shots.narration: 把新电源装回原来的位置。

shots.scene: 老李把线缆理顺，逐根拧紧端子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tidies the cables and tightens each terminal screw one by one with bare hands.
shots.narration: 理顺线缆，5根电源线逐根固定。

shots.scene: 老李对照平板上的空白接线示意图检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer compares the terminals with a simple wiring diagram of lines and colored dots on a tablet.
shots.narration: 对照参考图，再核对一遍接线顺序。

shots.scene: 端子和导线颜色一一对应，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icon of terminals and wires matched one to one by color with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一根都不能接错。

shots.scene: 老李拧回主板旁的固定螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refastens the screw near the circuit board that secures the power supply.
shots.narration: 拧回固定电源的螺丝。

shots.scene: 盖板挂钩对准销钉，老李推入并拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer aligns the side cover's three hooks with three pegs on the frame, pushes it in and tightens the screw.
shots.narration: 三个挂钩对准三个销钉，装回左盖。

shots.scene: 老李装回两侧把手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refits the handles on both sides and tightens them with the hex wrench.
shots.narration: 两侧把手装回拧紧。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the closed machine with step icons floating behind: a warning card, an hourglass, a long power supply and a bracket.
shots.narration: 专业人员，断电，等5分钟，戴手套。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 黄胶镊子剥，先抬左侧再取右侧。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着焊接机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the closed laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 支架挂钩朝外，接线对照参考图。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊接机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 激光电源换好了，下次见！
